_doc: The pause menu's OBJECTIVES tab (Update 04 section 4, DECISIONS T-066; docs/gravelight/OBJECTIVES.md). Read by ObjectiveLog (gravelight/ui/objective_log.gd), a pure model: it never reads the game itself, the pause menu hands it a snapshot. maps.<map_id>: current (the soft CURRENT OBJECTIVE: the first rule whose `when` holds and whose `done` does not), easter_egg (QuestManager quest ids), side (QuestManager quest ids, or tracked side quests built from match flags). quests.<quest_id>.steps.<step_id>: the three texts every step needs, one per spoiler level: done (plain words, shown once it is complete), hint (an in-character nudge for the current step at Hints), guide (a clear instruction plus where, at Full Guide), and where (a short location line, Full Guide only). Optional per step: nodes (scene node names to highlight on the MAP tab), nodes_random ({key, format}: node names from the quest's seeded picks; {g} = group, {v} = pick), pos ([x, y, z] when there is no node), progress ({flag, max} for flag steps; collect / sequence / kill_count / holdout steps count by themselves). Text tokens: {n} and {target} (the step's progress), {rand:<key>} (a seeded value; Full Guide only, and only once the step is current, i.e. after the squad has heard it). Conditions (current, side quest steps, show_when): {power}, {flag}, {flag_at_least: [flag, n]}, {zone_open}, {round_at_least}, {step: [quest, step]}, {quest_done}, {intel_match}, {jakub_in: [states]}, {exfil_active}, {setting}, {all: [...]}, {any: [...]}, {not: cond}. A future map adds a maps.<id> block and its quests' text; nothing in code changes.

current.text: The Carters' Road is open: get to the beacon in the yard
Open the way to the cellar (the door off the taproom, 1,500)
Turn on the power: throw the cellar lever
Survive to round 10
Survive.

side.title: The Man in the Coal Cage

steps.done: Found Jakub Ostrowski, locked in the coal cage under the inn.
steps.hint: Someone is calling from under the floor. The voice carries up from the old cellar.
steps.guide: Open the Old Cellar (Door 5, 1,250, from the cellar stair) and follow the voice to the coal cage.

steps.done: Jakub broke out of the cage with the coal shovel.
steps.hint: The cage is old and the coal window is open. Something will come for him through it. Be close when it does.
steps.guide: At round 5 a zombie climbs in through the coal window and bursts the cage hinge; Jakub fights it off with his shovel. Be there to help.

steps.hint: He waits by the cage. A tired man, a long way from home: talk to him.
steps.guide: Hold USE by the cage to talk to Jakub. GIVE HIM A GUN hands him the gun in your hands; NOT YET and he comes with his shovel. Either way he follows you.

steps.done: Held the inn until round 10, when the lamps went out.
steps.hint: The innkeeper's children were never found. Hold out long enough and the house will remember them.
steps.guide: Survive to round 10 with Homage Bosses on: the Cousins come.

steps.done: The Cousins are at rest. The ice cellar behind the coal room is open: their chalk drawings and the aunt's letter are inside.
steps.hint: Three girls who never stopped playing. Let them finish the game.
steps.guide: Kill all three Cousins on round 10 (the Hammer, the Reach, then Alix from the trapdoor behind the bar). The bricked-up ice cellar off the coal room opens on the clear.
steps.where: Old Cellar, the ice cellar off the coal room

current.text: The North Gate is open: get to the beacon at the Minehead
Open the path to the Generator Hall
Turn on the power: throw the Hauptschalter
Attune the 3 Resonance Pylons
Survive to round 30
Survive.

steps.done: Jakub came with you to Kaltenbrunn: the mine he walked out of two days ago.
Jakub showed you the Maintenance Stairs.
steps.hint: He worked this mine. Ask him the quick way down.
steps.guide: While Jakub is with you the Maintenance Stairs door costs 500 less.

current.text: The ramp is down: board the Kranich
Find the works' power: the assembly halls
Turn on the power: the Kraftzentrale's main breaker
Open the Great Hangar
Survive until the ramp comes down.
The exfil is open: get to the beacon
Open the path to the Pen Hall
Hang a ballast coffin on the crane hook
Open the way down to the pump room
Turn on the power: throw the Pumpenschalter
Survive.
Rip out the autopilot
Throw the auxiliary bus in the centre body
Get into the wings: the engine room and the gun blisters
Reach the cockpit
Hold on. Nobody is flying.
The console is unlocked: lift the cover and CANCEL
The Account Manager attends. Make her escalate.
Leave the landing dome: the concourse
Open the yard airlock or the store (the yard has no air: watch the gauge)
Reach the retention hall
Read the terms on the three columns
Open the Account
Cancel.

side.text: The Lodestone lifts a column's cap: a shorter read

current.text: Take the gantry lift up to the rocket
Get out of the wreck onto the salt
Reach the hangar and answer Dee's radio
Pull-start the generator in the motor pool
Open the laboratory hatch
The test pilot has the rocket's ignition key
Raise Fasbender on the radar shack's radio (power on)
Turn the key and enter the burn at the silo console
Hold the range.

side.text: Carry the impeller core from the salt to the office hatch

map00_radio.title: Glasmacher Calling
map00_radio._story_doc: T-086: story (a short what-is-going-on paragraph shown above the instruction at Hints and Full Guide while the step is current) and said (the VO line id whose words the tab quotes as the step's setup line; the pause menu looks the text up).

s1_notes.story: Since round two the field set behind the bar has been calling the squad by its own call sign: "Glasmacher calling Gravelight." Nobody outside London should know that name. The voice is a frightened man who says he is the reason the plane came down, and that he left frequencies in this house: the innkeeper listened to the works' channels and wrote them down on three numbered scraps. Find them and the squad can call him back.
s1_notes.done: Found the three frequency notes, I, II and III.
s1_notes.hint: Glasmacher's technician wrote his frequencies down and left them about the inn: three scraps, numbered like chapters. ({n}/3)
s1_notes.guide: Pick up the three notes: Note I (3.120) under the beer stein on the taproom mantel; Note II (5.785) in the technician's trunk in Upstairs Room 2 (Door 1, 750); Note III (7.440) nailed to the hayloft beam in the stable (Door 2, 1,000). ({n}/3)
s1_notes.where: Taproom mantel · Upstairs Room 2 · Stable hayloft

s2_tune.story: Three numbered frequencies, lowest first. Lock them on the bar radio in order and Glasmacher answers for real: who he is, what is in the salt under Kaltenbrunn, and where the squad has to go when the snow stops. A wrong lock is a burst of static that every dead thing outside can hear, and the order starts again. When the third lock lands, someone else cuts in on his frequency, cheerful and faint, and the house's tonic cabinets light up on his account.
s2_tune.done: Tuned the taproom radio: Glasmacher's message came through.
s2_tune.hint: The radio behind the bar keeps calling for Gravelight. Read the notes in their order and the dial will answer. ({n}/{target})
s2_tune.guide: At the field radio behind the taproom bar, hold USE and turn the dial: lock 3.120, then 5.785, then 7.440. A wrong frequency bursts static (and draws zombies) and starts the order again. ({n}/{target} locked)

s0_power.done: Threw the Hauptschalter: Kaltenbrunn has power.
s0_power.hint: The whole mine is dark. Somewhere below the chapel, a great switch waits for a hand.
s0_power.guide: Go down (the Lift, 1,250, or the Maintenance Stairs, 1,500), open the Generator Hall (1,500) and throw the Hauptschalter on its north wall.

s1_vault.done: Attuned the three Resonance Pylons; the Core Vault is open.
s1_vault.hint: Three crystals hum out of tune: one where the cage comes up, one where they prayed, one where they were measured. Tune them and something deep opens. ({n}/3)
s1_vault.guide: Attune the three Resonance Pylons (1,500 each, then hold the ring for 45 s): Pylon A at the Minehead, Pylon F in the Salt Chapel, Pylon H in the Laboratory Wing (2,000 door, needs power). The Core Vault opens when all three sing. ({n}/3)

s2a_radios.done: Heard Fasbender's three code fragments on the radios.
s2a_radios.hint: Fasbender said the codes are in the radios. Listen for the ones that crackle. ({n}/3)
s2a_radios.guide: Three radios crackle (you hear them within 12 m), one on the surface, one in the depths, one in the lab; their spots change each match. Use each to hear a two-digit fragment and whether it comes first, in the middle or last. ({n}/3)
s2a_radios.where: One radio on the surface, one in the depths, one in the lab

s2b_switchboard.done: Patched the code into the Admin switchboard: Fasbender spoke to us himself.
s2b_switchboard.hint: Six digits, three voices, one board in Administration. Mind which voice said 'first'. ({n}/{target})
s2b_switchboard.guide: At the switchboard in Administration, plug in the six digits: the 'first' fragment, then 'the middle', then 'last'. This match the code is {rand:code}. A wrong jack sparks and resets. ({n}/{target})

s3_build.done: Built the Totenglocke at the Generator Hall workbench.
s3_build.hint: A bell, a frame and a crank, hidden by men who wanted no more bells. Put them together where the turbines turn.
s3_build.guide: Collect the three Totenglocke parts (the spot changes each match): the bell in the Rail Yard (boxcar, signal box or locomotive cab), the firing frame in the Barracks (top bunk, quartermaster's cage or mess-hall stage), the crank in the Salt Chapel (bell-tower base, sacristy or confessional). Build it at the Generator Hall workbench.
s3_build.where: Rail Yard · Barracks · Salt Chapel, then the Generator Hall workbench

s4_key.done: Took the Overseer's Key from the Foreman, under the lit bell.
s4_key.hint: The Foreman keeps the key to what Reinholt locked away, and he only gives it up beneath a burning bell.
s4_key.guide: Shoot the great bell 14 m above the Salt Chapel altar with an upgraded (Crucible) weapon: it glows amber for 90 s (75 s in co-op) and calls the Foreman if he isn't about. Kill the Foreman inside the chapel while it glows; he drops the Overseer's Key.
s4_key.where: Salt Chapel, the bell above the altar

s5_reliquary.done: Opened the reliquary: Liesl's music box.
s5_reliquary.hint: A key, an altar, and something of hers that Reinholt would rather you left alone.
s5_reliquary.guide: Take the Overseer's Key to the Salt Chapel altar and use it: the reliquary opens on Liesl's music box. It plays a four-note melody; use it again to replay it.

s6_bells.done: Rang the four hidden bells in the music box's order.
s6_bells.hint: Four small bells hide in the mine, one for each note the music box plays. Ring them in her order. ({n}/4)
s6_bells.guide: Find the four small bells (one on the surface, one in Administration or the Barracks, one in the depths, one in the lab; the spots change each match) and shoot them in the melody's order. A wrong bell puts every glow out: start again. ({n}/4)
s6_bells.where: Surface · Admin or Barracks · depths · lab

s7_drummer.done: Caught Herr Tamtam and took the Nachtglas shard.
s7_drummer.hint: The little drummer in the Crate won't vanish next time. He marches. Don't let him drum away.
s7_drummer.guide: Use the Mystery Crate until Herr Tamtam moves it: this time he hops out and marches off for about 20 s. Shoot him once and pick up the Nachtglas shard. If he gets away, the Crate brings him back after two more uses.

s8a_place.done: Set the Nachtglas shard in the Crucible.
s8a_place.hint: The shard wants to go home to the fire that makes the guns sing. The switchboard, the bell and the drummer must all be behind you first.
s8a_place.guide: With the switchboard done, the Totenglocke built and the shard in hand, use the Crucible in the Core (no cost) to set the shard in it.

s8b_charge.done: Fed the heart: the Crucible is charged.
s8b_charge.hint: The heart hears only the bell. Toll it close to the pit. ({n}/{target})
s8b_charge.guide: Get {target} kills with the Totenglocke (either version) within 15 m of the heart's pit rim in the Core. Kills further out don't count. ({n}/{target})
s8b_charge.where: The Core, around the heart's pit

s9_heartstorm.hint: When the shard is full, wake the heart and stand your ground in its chamber.
s9_heartstorm.guide: Use the charged Crucible to start the Heartstorm, then hold the Core for 2:00 against Gängers, Bellringers and the Foreman (at 0:40 and 1:30). If everyone leaves or is down for 10 s it starts over; the charge is kept.

s10_ending.done: The heart of Kaltenbrunn is broken.

s1_cylinders.hint: Somebody hid a song in three pieces. Listen for a faint hum near a lantern, a prayer and a child's room. ({n}/3)
s1_cylinders.guide: Pick up the three wax cylinders (they hum within 4 m): on the guard's shelf behind a lantern in the Minehead gatehouse; in a Salt Chapel confessional (hold USE 1 s); on the nursery dresser in the Laboratory Wing (needs power and the Lab door). ({n}/3)
s1_cylinders.where: Minehead gatehouse · Salt Chapel confessional · Lab nursery

s2_phonograph.done: Played 'Lanterns Down Below' on the phonograph.
s2_phonograph.hint: Three cylinders and no music. The Kommandant kept a phonograph for his evenings.
s2_phonograph.guide: Take the cylinders to the phonograph in Reinholt's office (Administration, upstairs) and use it.

s1_tag.done: Found tag KB-4471: Nowak, T. · Wilcza Góra · transferred: COLD STORE.
s1_tag.hint: Wren's brother came through here. Among a hundred numbered tags, one hangs askew.
s1_tag.guide: In the Laboratory Wing's Intake room, use tag KB-4471 on the tag board (it glints when Wren is in the match).
s1_tag.where: Laboratory Wing, the Intake tag board

s1_power.hint: The town is dark. Somewhere a breaker waits.
s1_power.guide: Throw the main breaker in the Kraftzentrale, the annex off assembly hall 2 (Montage, 1,250).

s2_files.hint: The works kept paper on everything. Three files say what the Kranich is. ({n}/3)
s2_files.guide: Read the engine ledger (hall 2's office desk), the flight plan (the wind-tunnel office desk) and the crew list (the test-stand bunker). Each carries two digits of a PA extension. ({n}/3)

s3_pa_line.hint: The canteen stage has a house switchboard. The files know the number.
s3_pa_line.guide: On the canteen's PA board dial the three files' extensions in file order (I, II, III). Wittkamp answers and gives the hangar's door code.

s4_tunnel.done: Twenty of the dead went through the running tunnel.
s4_tunnel.hint: The wind tunnel still has a fan, and the fan still has a switch. ({n}/20)
s4_tunnel.guide: With the power on, run the wind tunnel from its fan control and kill 20 in the test section while it blows (the dead tumble). Reward: Skyhook Sekt's second tier free for the match. ({n}/20)

s5_kranfuehrer.done: The crane driver fell over the ramp; the hangar key is yours.
s5_kranfuehrer.hint: The hangar's crane has a driver. He keeps something the ramp needs, and he must fall in the right place.
s5_kranfuehrer.guide: Kill Der Kranführer while he is parked over the Kranich's ramp (his last phase, at 30%: climb the crane-rail catwalks and shoot the cab). Killed on the rails, he comes back; nothing is lost.

s6_board.hint: The ramp wants a key and a code. Then it wants you.
s6_board.guide: With the hangar key (the crane driver) and the door code (Wittkamp's line), hold [interact] on the ramp switch: the beacon lights at once, before act round 15. Board.

s7a_crew_tags.done: Three crew tags: Riedl, Haas, Pohl.
s7a_crew_tags.hint: Every seat has a harness buckled over nobody. Somebody left their names. ({n}/3)
s7a_crew_tags.guide: Take the three crew tags: a bunk, the radio room's tape deck, under a gunner's blister seat. ({n}/3)

s7_bordwart.done: The flight engineer fell at his station; the autopilot key is yours.
s7_bordwart.hint: Someone is still in the port engine room. He has the key and he will not leave.
s7_bordwart.guide: Kill Der Bordwart in the port engine room (Triebwerk, 1,250 from the port wing). He drops the autopilot key.

s8_london.hint: The aft blister looks back the way you came.
s8_london.guide: The London window plays once the crew tags are found (or at act round 3 on the clock).

s9_bomb_run.hint: The racks drop one by one. Jam what you can reach.
s9_bomb_run.guide: When the bay doors open, hold [interact] on each rack's shackle before it drops (one every 35 s). Marked casings are duds; leave them, take the next.

s10_autopilot.done: The autopilot is out. The Kranich is falling.
s10_autopilot.hint: The cockpit door takes the key. The cradle takes both hands.
s10_autopilot.guide: Unlock the autopilot with the key, then hold [interact] on the cradle to rip it out. The crash follows.

s11a_dee.done: Dee answered. The hangar's side door is hers to open.
s11a_dee.hint: Someone is still alive on the range. Her radio is in the hangar.
s11a_dee.guide: Reach the hangar and hold [interact] on the supply cage's radio.

s11b_choice.done: The core is placed. Peg has chosen.
s11b_choice.hint: The impeller core on the salt belongs somewhere. Hale thinks he knows where.
s11b_choice.guide: Carry the core from the lakebed to the hangar cradle (pistol only, no sprint). Then choose: keep it for the rocket, or hand it through the office hatch.

s12_lodestone.hint: The program left three parts of one device: the hangar, the tower, the lab.
s12_lodestone.guide: Bring the relay coil, the gyro cradle and the lead-glass lens to the lab workbench.

s12b_burn.hint: The radar shack's radio reaches a mountain in Bavaria, once the generator runs.
s12b_burn.guide: Throw the generator, then hold [interact] on the radar shack's radio. Write the three numbers down.

s13_testpilot.done: The Test Pilot is down. He had the ignition key.
s13_testpilot.hint: He leaps. Something that lifts could catch him in the air.
s13_testpilot.guide: Catch him once mid-leap with the Lodestone's lift, then finish him. He keeps the key otherwise and comes back.

s14_rocket.done: The rocket is lit. The gantry lift is up.
s14_rocket.hint: The silo console takes a key and three numbers.
s14_rocket.guide: Turn the ignition key at the silo console, enter the burn, then take the gantry lift.

s15a_yard.hint: The relay's columns are past the yard. The yard has no air.
s15a_yard.guide: Open the concourse's airlock to the yard (watch the AIR gauge; the posts refill it).

s15_columns.done: Every column is dark. The sign has lost its letters.
s15_columns.hint: The terms were always on the backs of the machines. The columns quote them.
s15_columns.guide: Hold [interact] on each column's terms plate and read (the Lodestone's lift on the cap makes it quick). All three, any order.

s16_account.hint: Three dark columns open the last door.
s16_account.guide: With the columns dark, the Account's door opens. Go in.

s17_manager.done: She has escalated. The console is unlocked.
s17_manager.hint: She never dies. She can only be made to step away.
s17_manager.guide: Fight the Account Manager through her three contracts until she escalates. Fling her shield-cells into the shaft with the Lodestone.

s18_cancel.hint: Nobody cancels. That is a claim, not a rule.
s18_cancel.guide: Lift the console's cover, vote, and turn the key.

s1_models.hint: Someone in this works built little wings for fun. Three of them are still around. ({n}/3)
s1_models.guide: Find the three glider models: the canteen stage, beside hall 2's jig, by the test-section glass. They glint after the wind tunnel has run (or with Fine Print Fernet). ({n}/3)

s2_hatch.done: The models are on Jette's desk; her logbook read itself.
s2_hatch.hint: The tunnel office has a hatch in its wall.
s2_hatch.guide: Hold [interact] on the office hatch in the wind tunnel's east wall. Reward: Skyhook Sekt tier II free, the Jette calling card, the Archive entry.

s1_rim.done: You saw it from the rim.
s1_rim.hint: The crack on the Moon is a short walk through nothing.
s1_rim.guide: Cross the yard to the crater rim's marker with a full suit of air (a hop helps) and hold [interact].

s1_rule.done: Dee's three things are in the cage.
s1_rule.hint: Dee's yard rule asks for three things. She said what, on the radio.
s1_rule.guide: Bring Dee a casing from the wreck on the lake bed, a coil from the bomber in the hangar and the honey jar from the lab's kitchen corner; hold [interact] on each.

s1_tags.done: Three crew tags found: Riedl, Haas, Pohl.
s1_tags.hint: Every harness aboard is buckled over nobody. Somebody left their names behind. ({n}/3)
s1_tags.guide: Find the three crew tags: on the first and second harness bunks in the centre body, and under the aft blister's gun seat in the gun blisters. ({n}/3)
s1_tags.where: Mittelrumpf bunks · Kanzel, the aft blister

s2_roster.done: The three names are back on the roster.
s2_roster.hint: The radio room keeps a crew list. Three names on it have been rubbed out.
s2_roster.guide: Read the tags against the BESATZUNGSLISTE board in the radio room (the centre body's starboard wall, by the aux bus).

s3_transmission.done: The Bordfunk played the crew's last transmission.
s3_transmission.hint: The tape deck has a reel with the same three names on it.
s3_transmission.guide: Hold USE on the Bordfunk's tape deck in the radio room to play the last reel.

s0a_load.done: Hooked a coffin on the loading crane.
s0a_load.hint: The pumps won't run while the crane's sling hangs empty.
s0a_load.guide: Lift a lead coffin off a pallet (the north apron or the crane bay) and hook it on the crane in the crane bay.

s0_power.done: Threw the Pumpenschalter: the harbour has power.
s0_power.hint: Down in the lower pens, a switch is waiting for the crane to be fed.
s0_power.guide: Open the Pump Room door from the Pen Hall and throw the Pumpenschalter on the east wall of the lower pens.

s1_ballast.done: Three coffins went over the side at the sea stairs.
s1_ballast.hint: The coffins don't have to go where the schedule says.
s1_ballast.guide: Carry three coffins to the sea stairs on the quay's north parapet and put them over the side (they come back on their pallets).

s2a_radios.hint: Three sets in this harbour are keying the same traffic.
s2a_radios.guide: Listen to the radios in the cannery office, on the workshop bench and in U-1047's radio room. Each gives a four-letter group and its place in the order.

s2_cipher.done: The rotor machine answered: the depth mark and the curtain code.
s2_cipher.hint: The signal tower has a machine with three wheels.
s2_cipher.guide: In the signal tower set the three wheels to the first letters of the radio groups, in the order the radios said (message one, two, three), then pull the lever.

s3_log.done: Read all four pages of U-1047's log.
s3_log.hint: The captain's log came apart. Somebody hid the pages.
s3_log.guide: Find the four log pages: the captain's cabin, the radio room, the crane office and the pump-deck locker (each has two possible spots).

s4_parts.hint: A diver's pump, a harpoon head and a shard of something that went into the sea.
s4_parts.guide: Find the diver's pump in the lower pens, the harpoon head in the workshop, and the coffin shard on the sea stairs after the third coffin goes over; build it at the crane office bench.
s4_parts.where: Lower pens, workshop, sea stairs, crane office

s5a_injector.done: Turned a new injector on the lathe.
s5a_injector.hint: Brecht: the lathe's belt only grips wet.
s5a_injector.guide: During a flood (high or spring tide), start the lathe in the workshop and hold it for 30 seconds.

s5b_battery.done: Lifted a battery cell out of the lower pens.
s5b_battery.hint: Brecht: when you lift the cell, the lights go. Bring your own.
s5b_battery.guide: Start the battery cell by pump 1 in the lower pens and hold for 30 seconds in the dark (the searchlight helps).

s5c_sequence.guide: In U-1047's engine room, start the panel and hold for 45 seconds while the drowned pull at the hull.

s5_diesels.guide: Finish the injector, the battery cell and the start sequence.

s6_boss.done: The captain gave up the ignition key.
s6_boss.hint: Something is coming up in dock 2.
s6_boss.guide: Defeat DER KIELHOLER (the helmet glass, then the glow) and take the ignition key he drops. If he dives for good, the key floats up at the dock edge.

s7_key.done: Turned the ignition key in the tower.
s7_key.hint: A key needs its lock, and the curtain needs its code.
s7_key.guide: In the signal tower, turn the ignition key at the chart table (the teletype's code must be printed).

s8_curtain.hint: The way out of the pen is shut.
s8_curtain.guide: Pull the curtain lever at the end of pier 2. The storm and the spring tide come in.

s9_sail.guide: Board U-1047 and cast off at the helm by the tower (or she casts off when everyone is aboard). Hold the deck for 150 seconds.

s10_ending.done: She went down where the chart says it is deepest.

bs._doc: Bolt & Sprocket planets: the same tab in the holo skin. Main mission = the HUD's mission tracker; side quests = data/bs/story/quests.json for the planet; gold bolts and memos = the level file's gold_bolts / memos; challenges = per-planet lists here (none exist yet: a planet adds its own block).
